export: LADOTD / LSU CARTS crash extract (Louisiana Crash Tool export, or a DOTD Highway Safety Section data request)
spec: No public column list found. DOTD Crash Data Analysis Guidelines (Sept 2025, p. 11: 'Contact DOTD Highway Safety Section to gain access'; https://dotd.louisiana.gov/media/cz2nqota/crash-data-analysis-guide-20250903.pdf) and LTRC FR 721 (2026, crash / DOTD / vehicle / pedestrian tables matched on crash number, https://www.ltrc.la.gov/pdf/2026/FR_721.pdf). Saved in ~/.hermes/state-manuals/la/.
layout_seen_live: Two consultants' public copies of the DOTD file show the field names (shapefile-truncated to 10 characters): Toole Design 'new_orleans_crashes' 2015-2019 (https://services6.arcgis.com/bom7L4u7y1k0qkF1/arcgis/rest/services/new_orleans_crashes/FeatureServer/0) and 'DOTD_crash_data' (https://services6.arcgis.com/1fGAZVgZnPx4zcNH/arcgis/rest/services/DOTD_crash_data/FeatureServer/0), checked 2026-11-08. Real export headers are probably the untruncated names (PRI_ROAD_NAME, INTER_ROAD, ...); confirm on one sample.
unit: one row per crash; vehicle, pedestrian and DOTD (roadway) tables join on crash_num

map.primary_road: pri_road_n (raw, e.g. 'APRICOT') with its type in pri_road_d; consultants' cleaned copy r_pri_road ('APRICOT ST'). State routes: hwy_type_c + pri_hwy_nu, LRS route lrs_id + lrs_logmil
map.sec_distance: pri_dist (number) with unit pri_measur 'FT' or 'MI' (blank with a distance = feet in the sample)
map.severity: severity_c. Files up to about 2020 use letters A-E: A Fatal -> K, B Severe -> A, C Moderate -> B, D Complaint -> C, E No injury/PDO -> O (2023 guide p. 5: injury SPF uses crashes 'where Severity is not "E" (Property Damage Only)'; category names from LTRC FR 721 tables). The 2025 guide uses KABCO letters directly (p. 5: 'is not "O"'): check which coding the export uses before reading it
map.collision_type: man_coll_c (code letter; decode from the export's data dictionary)
map.lat_lon: dotd_latit / dotd_longi (DOTD's map-spotted point, on 98.5% of the Orleans 2019 sample); officer GPS orig_latit / orig_longi (0 on most 2019 rows)
map.is_freeway: hwy_type_c / road_type_ (codes; Interstate rows carry pri_road_n 'I-10')

pri_measur_with_distance.note: 2019 rows with a non-zero pri_dist (7,811 of 19,963)

crash_costs_dotd.source: DOTD Crash Data Analysis Guidelines, Sept 2025, Appendix-A Crash Cost, p. 19 (2023 cost)
